changes: New core/version-bump.ts: structural read/write of the 3 version sync points (root package.json + packages/main/package.json via JSON.parse/stringify top-level .version; lattice-brand.ts LATTICE_CLI_VERSION via a line-anchored, comment-stripped, exactly-one-match regex), nextPatch (patch-only), readSyncedVersion (drift fail-loud), applyPatchBump (atomic with rollback on write/verify failure), bumpVersionOnDoneMerge (skip line or applyPatchBump+git add+chore:bump commit, loud recovery). Wired into done-effects.ts applyDoneMergeEffects after the merge and before the dist rebuild, gated on shouldBuildDoneMainPackageForChangedPaths, under the merge-lock. + 64-assertion hermetic smoke registered in lattice.config.json.
usage: DONE-merge any story that changes packages/main/src code (or package.json) to local main: the version auto-increments by one patch across all 3 sync points and a 'chore: bump lattice cli to X' commit lands on main; the merge log prints '✓ version auto-bumped X → Y across 3 sync points after DONE merge'. A metadata-only merge prints '✓ version bump skipped (no material code change)'. No manual bump needed.
expectedOutcome: A material-code DONE merge bumps all 3 sync points to the next patch, commits 'chore: bump lattice cli to <new>' on main, and prints the auto-bumped line; a metadata-only merge prints the skip line and leaves the version unchanged.
actualTranscript: Live demo: bumpVersionOnDoneMerge (shouldBump=true) -> '✓ version auto-bumped 0.3.10 → 0.3.11 across 3 sync points after DONE merge', git calls = [add 3 files, commit -m chore: bump lattice cli to 0.3.11], brand now LATTICE_CLI_VERSION='0.3.11'; (shouldBump=false) -> '✓ version bump skipped (no material code change)'. validate --story coverage 28/28; smoke 64 assertions; full validate 7/7 green.
outcomeDiff: None — actual matches expected on every point (bump line, git add of all 3, chore:bump commit message, bumped brand, metadata skip line).
limitations: Patch-only by design (no semantic minor/major inference). Bumps only on material-code merges (reuses the dist-rebuild gate); metadata-only merges never bump. Documented accepted limitation: a regex parser cannot fully parse TS — a line-start export inside a template literal in the controlled lattice-brand.ts is out of scope (the runtime cannot depend on the TS compiler, a devDependency); all realistic modes (comments, duplicates, drift, partial/verify-failure) are handled and fail loud. The feature cannot bump its OWN installing merge (the merge is run by pre-merge code); it bumps from the next material story.
pitfalls: Genuine dual-host review was decisive: Codex (host 2) caught 6 real MAJORs across rounds 1-3 that the Claude lanes missed — first-substring replace vs structural JSON, BRAND regex matching //-line then /* */-block comments, post-write-verify throw bypassing rollback, and the smoke 'reads first' blessing ambiguity. 5 rounds to converge (MAJOR count 3->2->1->0). Lesson: a regex 'TS parser' is leaky — strip comments + anchor to line-start + exactly-one-match guard + structural JSON for package.json, and fail loud on any ambiguity. materialHash EXCLUDES .lattice/, so finding_resolve/evidence commits don't drift it; only code commits + main merges do.
